credits.title: Spaceboy
credits.overview: Max is six years old and is discovering the world, together with his older brother Billy. However, Billy doesn't understand the world very well, but he does know a lot about space. The two brothers set out to send a message into space, but things do not go as planned.

credits.title: Coward
credits.overview: Surrounded by brutality but bound by a tender intimacy, two World War I soldiers find a fragile sanctuary of love and art amid the shadows of the Belgian trenches.

credits.title: Tussen oud en nieuw / entre deux
credits.overview: During the Christmas holidays, Amir and Amira, both ten years old, end up in a shelter with their mother. On New Year's Eve, they are determined that the performance they've been planning for weeks, can still go ahead.

credits.title: Het was niet koud, het sneeuwde niet
credits.overview: Two men wait in a deserted landscape for something or someone important. The weather is capricious, their conversations absurd. They meet a master and a slave. Will they be able to provide more clarity about their endless waiting?

credits.overview: The story of Staf, who isolates himself in a village full of lonely and superficial people, in an absurd and surrealistic way.
